dataset: SYNTHETIC - fictional trader, usrId SYNTH0001; not real data
rounding: each charge rounded to paise (half-up) per round trip; totals are sums of the rounded per-trade values
brokerage_rule: Rs10 x distinct executed orders per round trip (entry order + exit order); partial fills of one order = one order; expired worthless = entry order only

scenario_columns.net_pnl: headline: Rs10 per executed order (Kotak Neo Trade Free plans after the first 30 days, orders not placed via Trade API)
scenario_columns.net_pnl_trade_api_zero_brokerage: same trades if every order went via Kotak Neo Trade API (Rs0 brokerage; GST then only on exchange + SEBI)
scenario_columns.net_pnl_if_intraday_min_10_or_0p05pct: UNCONFIRMED reading: MIS orders charged min(Rs10, 0.05% of order premium value); NRML Rs10

expired_worthless_rule: long option with no exit row, expiry passed: exit price 0, no STT, no exit brokerage, turnover = buy value only

habit_parameters.revenge: new round trip opened <= 10 min after a net-losing exit; strong if qty >= 1.5x that losing trade's qty
habit_parameters.overtrading_day: round trips opened that day >= max(8, 2.0 x median daily count); median = 4.0, threshold = 8 (spec default for the 220-trade demo is max(15, 2.5 x median))
habit_parameters.expiry_day: round trip opened on its own contract's expiry date (0 DTE)
habit_parameters.hold_asymmetry: flag if median net-loser hold >= 2.0x median net-winner hold; per-trade tag 'loser_held_long' = loser held >= 2.0x median winner hold
